description:
Cast Red Sun's Twilight with X equal to 5 by paying {5}{R}{R}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Red Sun's Twilight targeting itself and up to four other artifacts.
Resolve that copy, destroying all its targets then creating a token copy of each artifact destroyed.
Repeat from step 3.
